amendment.information_inspected: Only source hashes and first-event timestamps; no models fitted and no market outcomes or label distributions inspected.
amendment.preserved: Dates, reserved dates, model family, hyperparameters, split design, cost and latency grids, threshold selection and inference rules.
amendment.reason: Official source coverage begins after the registered midnight window on May16 and May17 for both assets. Choose the first common whole-hour two-hour window after all first-event timestamps,12:00–14:00UTC.

data.scope_limit: Only the fixed12:00–14:00UTC two-hour window is studied; these are not full-day returns or independent ticks.
data.source: Binance Vision USD-M daily bookTicker and aggTrades

execution.fee_status: All costs are research scenarios, not a verified account tier; primary 1bps and zero slippage are explicitly assumed.
execution.funding_policy: No scheduled00:00,08:00or16:00UTC eight-hour funding settlement occurs inside12:00–14:00UTC; positions must close inside this window.
execution.liquidity: Every raw best-quote update and observed quantity; no synthetic liquidity, no calibrated impact/passivequeue claim.
execution.sessions: Separate funded session accounts; require zero ending inventory, report any residual as failure rather than reset; aggregate equal-capital session returns.

next_experiment_rule: Do not tune on these OOS results and report them again as fresh evidence. Any follow-up must be registered before opening unseen sessions.
objective: Improve out-of-sample executable net payoff under a common persistent-account taker simulator.

report.candidate_status: Research candidate only if improvement survives costs on both assets and more than one OOSdate; otherwise reject or inconclusive.
report.inference: Descriptive only with three distinct OOS dates. Do not invoke 20-fold acceptance or annualize two-hour session PnL.
primary: paired net PnL difference versus ridge_default

selection.cost_sensitivity: Each predeclared fee scenario fits its own validation threshold; latency stress uses same selected threshold and no retuning.
selection.metric: validation stateful net PnL at each predeclared cost scenario
selection.primary_comparison: Paired same-date aggregate net PnL difference versus ridge_default at1bps per side and100ms latency.
